old_caption: The video captures a dancer in a modern dance studio. The dancer, dressed in a bright yellow outfit consisting of a sleeveless top and a matching skirt, is the focal point of the scene. Her long hair is styled in two braids. She is moving through a choreographed motion, with her arms raised and transitioning, visible in the reflection of the large mirror along one wall. The lighting is bright, illuminating the dancer's outfit and highlighting the clean lines of the studio. The wooden floor beneath her feet adds a warm contrast to the cool tones of the walls and ceiling. The overall atmosphere is focused on the dancer's dynamic movement.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant dance performance set in a modern dance studio. The dancer, dressed in a bright yellow outfit consisting of a sleeveless top and a matching skirt, is the focal point of the scene. Her long hair is styled in two braids, adding to her energetic appearance. She performs a series of dynamic dance moves, her arms raised high and then brought down in a fluid motion, showcasing her agility and rhythm. The studio features large mirrors along one wall, reflecting her movements and creating an illusion of multiple dancers. The lighting is bright, illuminating the dancer's outfit and highlighting the clean lines of the studio. The wooden floor beneath her feet adds a warm contrast to the cool tones of the walls and ceiling. As she dances, her movements are precise and expressive, conveying a sense of joy and passion for dance. The overall atmosphere is lively and engaging, drawing the viewer into the performance.
caption: The video captures a dancer with long dark braided hair, wearing a neon-yellow sleeveless top, pleated skirt, and yellow leg warmers, standing with her back to the camera and facing a large wall mirror on the right. The mirror reflects her front, and the reflected figure moves in exact lockstep, confirming a single person. Her arms are already raised wide in a diagonal V, held with subtle drifts while her left heel lifts off the floor. The arms then rotate inward and upward toward a near-vertical overhead position as the hands rise. The elbows bend and the hands lower from overhead to head and shoulder level, briefly crossing in front of the chest. The posture settles into a flexed, bent-arm stance with fists raised near the shoulders. Small up-and-down pumping motions continue. Throughout, the feet shift weight and spread apart while the torso stays oriented toward the mirror. The ceiling track lights, curtain, and white walls remain fixed, so all visible motion comes from the dancer's limbs.
